Hi all,

I'm requesting approval to open a backfill requisition for a Sr. ML Engineer on the Search team (REQ-2026-0310-ML-SR). Anthony gave notice last week and his last day is 4/3. This is a backfill tied to an internal restructure (we're consolidating two smaller feature teams into one to remove overlap).

Why this role matters:
- Critical owner for the ranking infra work (low-latency KV cache redesign) that ships in H2.
- Without coverage we'll risk delivery slippage for the recommender rollout (impacting Q3 roadmap).

Proposed details:
- Level: Senior (equivalent to L4) — open to discussing L5 if comp constraints allow
- Proposed comp band: see attached comp_band_reference.xlsx (mid of band)
- Target start: as early as 4/20 to allow interviewing and ramp

Asks:
1) Finance/People: confirm headcount and budget code so we can create the req in Greenhouse.
2) Recruiter: please begin sourcing immediately for a backfill; sync up on the interview loop.
3) Hiring manager: Vivek, please confirm interviewers and any gating criteria (e.g., take-home coding exercise).

I've attached a short req write-up (REQ-2026-0310-ML-SR.pdf). Dev, please start outreach to the network and staffing partners; Marcus, pls confirm budget availability.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Director, Search & Ranking
Redwood Inference

1) Headcount vs. new hire: confirm this is strictly a backfill (no net-new HC).
2) Cost owner / budget code: Marcus, can you confirm this will be charged to Search R&D (GL 4201) and whether we have available bucket for Q2?

If the finance answer is yes on budget and we keep it L4, I am supportive of opening the req. If you want to push to L5, let's flag comp and get HR sign-off.
